name: Air Wedge / Door Frame Separation
description: An air wedge is inserted into a door gap and slowly inflated to widen the gap between the door and frame. This creates access for other bypass tools — J-tool, film attack, UDT — that require more clearance than the natural door gap provides. Air wedges are low-noise, non-destructive, and compatible with most commercial door frames. They are a force multiplier for the rest of the latch and door hardware bypass toolkit.

blue.det: Audible air pumping sound; visible frame distortion; door open alert if monitored; camera footage of approach.
blue.cm: Reinforced door frames and strike plates; door alarms on all access-controlled doors; anti-spread door hardware; camera coverage of all entry points.
